p3.name: Codora
p3.desc: A Real-Time Collaborative Code Editor that allows users to write, run, and debug code in multiple programming languages. It features real-time collaboration, file management (download/open). Built with modern web technologies for seamless user experience.

p2.name: AyushmaanChain
p2.desc: AyushmaanChain is a blockchain-based healthcare platform that enables secure, tamper-proof management of medical records, prescription NFTs, and drug traceability. It ensures real-time verification, decentralized storage, and role-based access control for doctors, patients, and pharmacies. Built with modern blockchain technologies to deliver a transparent and trustworthy healthcare ecosystem.

p1.name: HomeHub
p1.desc: HomeHub is a home service request platform connecting residents with registered electricians, plumbers, and other professionals. It features secure payments, real-time service tracking, role-based access control, availability booking, reviews, and media storage on AWS S3. Built using Spring Boot and React, deployed on AWS EC2 with Nginx and SSL for production readiness.
